bootstrap: 1000 paired resamples of whole corruption or checkpoint units with RNG seed 20260921; descriptive low-N intervals only
comparison: constant radius is a threshold on the common point score, so matched-exposure selected sets must be identical; scaled radius may change ranking
estimand: equal recorded-cell mean paired-oracle regret; false ADAPT includes B <= 0; ABSTAIN deploys frozen fallback
information: all arms share one predictor fitted without held-out outcomes; decision records reject all outcome fields; all decisions precede scoring
limitations: All inputs are historically opened retrospective panels; this protocol is not prospective preregistration.
Stream seeds, repeated conditions, related corruptions and three models are not independent deployments.
Finite cell/group radii are calculations, not established coverage for a new natural environment: exchangeability and domain transport are not established.

Environment-max calibration excludes all environments represented in fit or tune. The grouped-cell design generally leaves zero such environments and cannot supply a finite new-environment radius; this unavailable result must remain explicit.

Conditional-risk binomial guarantees require independent exchangeable semantic groups; that assumption is not established for these historical panels. The upper bounds are descriptive under this study.
Conditional-risk group harm differs from cell-level false-ADAPT conditional rate; both are explicitly reported and cannot be substituted.
Mixed-checkpoint records retain missing original execution evidence and historic outcome-based panel selection; B6 remains descriptive.
Saved aggregate features may derive from in-sample, reused, or related images; this study establishes held-out record arithmetic and grouping only, not new raw-data execution provenance.
Feature replay timing excludes candidate adaptation, neural inference, dataset reading, calibration maintenance in production and image-level memory.
No delayed-label adaptive-conformal arm, native TTALine/AETTA rerun, Mondrian sweep, bootstrap significance test, prospective claim, or deployment count is added here.
Scores are accuracies on [0,1]; equal recorded-cell weighting is not deployment-frequency weighting. Strictly zero-benefit ADAPT is counted as nonpositive harm event with zero harm magnitude.

policies.conditional_risk: fixed threshold family; group harm means any nonpositive ADAPT in a semantic group conditional on any ADAPT in that group; one-sided Clopper-Pearson delta/M bound; choose among eligible thresholds by tune harm-weight-5 loss; no eligible threshold => ABSTAIN
policies.constant_cell: exact finite-sample residual rank ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha)); rank > n gives infinity
policies.constant_group: one worst absolute residual per semantic calibration group; exact rank or infinity
policies.environment_max: one worst absolute residual per calibration corruption environment absent from BOTH fit and tune; only those environments count; exact rank or infinity. Reused fit/tune environments cannot supply independent calibration units.
policies.fixed_margin: select each harm-weight margin by tune loss only; tied loss chooses highest margin; strict inequalities and ABSTAIN between +/-margin
policies.point: ADAPT iff common predicted benefit > 0; FREEZE otherwise
policies.scaled_cell: same exact rank on abs(calibration residual)/fit-only learned scale

splits.fit_tune_cal: SHA256([fold name,semantic group]) order; floor(n_groups/4) calibration, next same number tune, rest fit
splits.outer_checkpoint: leave one checkpoint out and rotate four held-out semantic-group partitions; every row scored once
splits.outer_cifar: leave one complete corruption type out, separate method
splits.outer_imagenet: leave one complete noise type out, separate method
splits.outer_joint: hold out one checkpoint and one corruption; fit/tune/cal exclude both
splits.scale_fit: three grouped OOF folds within fit only; GBRT predicts log abs OOF residual; exp clipped to exp([-7,0]) then floor .001
splits.semantic_group: condition with terminal repeat component removed; all stream seeds and repeats kept together

utility: positive benefit forgone + harm_weight * magnitude of accepted negative benefit; harm weights 1,5,20 prespecified
